treatment_records.name: prednisone
treatment_records.reason_stopped: wreaked havoc on blood sugar control

evidence_notes: Michael, 42, diagnosed with Crohn's 3 years ago, with pre-existing type 2 diabetes. Initially thought to be diabetic gastroparesis. Tried prednisone (worsened diabetes), mesalamine (no improvement), and methotrexate (liver issues). Stelara was recommended but insurance denied due to high cost ($800/month). Currently on budesonide. Financial assistance is being sought. Also dealing with anemia and arthritis related to Crohn's. High out-of-pocket costs for Stelara are a major barrier.
